policy: Treat each entry as an acquisition route, not evidence for a historical conclusion. Preserve source wording, date, identifier, rights, retrieval path, and known interface limitations.

automated_providers.name: Deutsches Zeitungsportal / Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek
automated_providers.authentication: DDB API key in DDB_API_KEY environment variable; official DDB API documentation says registered users must create an API key.
automated_providers.coverage_note: Full-text newspaper page search, with date/title/place/provider/language metadata and highlighted OCR snippets in the currently observed newspaper Solr collection. Verify collection schema against live responses.
notes: Search hit totals are page counts, not counts of unique articles or relevant historical arguments.
Search results are relevance-ordered; date bounds must be applied in the query. Do not treat returned order as chronology.

The official API docs describe the general Search API and key requirements; the newspaper-specific Solr field layout is based on the live portal's observed index interface and is guarded by response-schema checks.

automated_providers.name: Austrian National Library, ANNO
automated_providers.authentication: No key observed for the current AnnoSearch web-app backend; endpoint is undocumented and may change without notice.
notes: This adapter is disabled unless explicitly opted into. It validates JSON response shape and fails loudly on endpoint drift.
ANNO's linked-data service provides RDF metadata records at data.onb.ac.at/ANNO/{id}.rdf; issue identifiers are documented by the IIIF API.
The IIIF service has separate age/access restrictions; do not infer that a missing IIIF manifest means OCR text is unavailable.
The supplied 1924 issue PDF is a user-provided seed and is not fetched by this undocumented API adapter.

automated_providers.name: Library of Congress, Chronicling America
notes: JSON API; use for U.S. newspaper coverage and OCR page results.
Coverage and query semantics differ from German/Austrian newspaper archives.

automated_providers.name: Internet Archive
notes: Advanced Search has a 10,000-result paging limit for sorted results; this harvester deliberately takes a bounded sample per query.
Automatic downloads require an explicit open-license or public-domain indicator and obey the configured byte limit.

automated_providers.name: Crossref REST API
notes: Bibliographic metadata and links; not a full-text search engine.
A Crossref record is not proof that the linked publication has been read or supports a claim.

automated_providers.name: OpenAlex
notes: Searches works metadata, abstracts, and available indexed full text; OA locations and licensing are retained separately.
An OpenAlex OA flag alone does not qualify a file for automatic download; explicit license evidence is also required.

automated_providers.name: OAI-PMH repositories
notes: The endpoint must be supplied by the operator.
ListRecords requests are bounded by --oai-max-batches. A run that stops at this ceiling is explicitly incomplete, not an exhaustive repository harvest.

manual_or_catalogue_routes.name: Deutsches Zeitungsportal browser search
manual_or_catalogue_routes.capture_method: Save the rendered search results page as HTML and import with --import-html; retain the original text/export separately where possible.
notes: Do not scrape undocumented UI endpoints when the official API path is available.
The supplied 2026-11-05 search capture reports 42,708 hits for the literal query 'vierte dimension'; this is a portal count, not a relevance count.

manual_or_catalogue_routes.name: Kalliope Union Catalogue of Personal Papers and Autographs
notes: Use catalogue records as discovery leads; order/view manuscript items under each repository's access terms.
